info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Seafood Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Seafood Notebook Detail API facilitates the addition of comprehensive details to seafood catalogs. This endpoint allows users to create new entries that enrich the seafood data repository, ensuring that the catalog is up-to-date and informative. Businesses utilizing this API can manage their seafood offerings effectively, making it essential for seafood suppliers, wholesalers, and retailers. Typical use cases include updating specifications, adding descriptions, and enhancing product information to improve customer engagement.

post.summary: Create a new detail in the seafood notebook.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new entry in the seafood notebook, which can be used to store important information and details related to seafood items. Provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully create a new detail.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details of seafood items in the seafood notebook. It is required to contain the necessary fields as specified in the schema, ensuring proper submission of data for processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogSeafoodNotebookDetailReques.title: Seafood Notebook Request Body

seafood_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the seafood notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the seafood notebook entry.

quantity.description: The quantity of seafood being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of seafood requested.
